name: fix-specs-risen-floors
about: Devil Forgemaster risen come along to the next floor (the user, 2026-10-25: 'necro summons not coming with you between floors'). The game carries every saveable summon itself (PlayerRecord.Save's summons array, re-produced by Player's constructor); mods/summons now tracks the risen producers (players/hwp/specs/forgemaster/risen/) as it does the crusaders and produces any shortfall on the next floor, logging '[HWP:summons] floor restore: N in the snapshot, M already live, K produced'. plan_forgemaster section risen_floors: two risen bandit brutes at 60% HP, `hwp finishlevel`, on the next floor (its enemies killed the moment it is up) both stand at that HP less the decay over the change (RisenDecay: 1% per 3 s; 20261025-181000 read 0.58 and 0.407 after 2.5 s among 25 brutes), the restore line adds up to 2 (that run: 2 already live, 0 produced, the game carried them), and the log has no 'Exception when saving summons' (the catch in PlayerRecord.Save that would silently drop every summon).

steps.pattern: \[HWP:summons\] self-check done: 3/3 tracked units, the Forgemaster's risen tracked
\[HWP:summons\] floor restore: 2 in the snapshot, \d+ already live, \d+ produced
